name: Oryx Universal College (Liverpool John Moores University)
tests: No SAT/ACT needed; admission is based on school-leaving results. English: IELTS or equivalent.

name: San Diego State University Georgia (SDSU Georgia)
tests: US-style admission with English proficiency required (programmes are taught in English); see SDSU Georgia admissions for details.

name: Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi
tests: Most bachelor's programmes are taught in French, with a Diploma in Intensive French for beginners; some science bachelor's (physics, mathematics/data science for AI) are in English. English proof: IELTS Academic 5.0 or TOEFL iBT 64 (valid 2 years) or equivalent; some majors may require an English proficiency exam.
strengths: Mathematics and Data Science for AI

name: University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST)
tests: No SAT/ACT needed; admission is based on school-leaving results. English: IELTS/TOEFL or UDST placement.

name: VCUarts Qatar (Virginia Commonwealth University School of the Arts in Qatar)
tests: SAT/ACT not central; the portfolio and school record matter most. English: TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo for non-native speakers.

name: Weill Cornell Medicine-Qatar
tests: SAT or ACT required; no fixed cutoff, but high scores are expected. English: TOEFL or Academic IELTS; waived with SAT Reading & Writing 650+ or ACT English+Reading 30+.
